title: Anping Tree House
scope: Standing roofless warehouse sections of Anping Tree House, their three banyan groups and the restored wooden walkway and black steel viewing platforms.
limitations: The garden boundary and outside paths come from the native map. Individual warehouse outlines, internal layout, wall heights, and the placement and profiles of roots and canopies are estimates using the published aggregate area and descriptions.

The modern wooden visitor walk, stairs and three black steel platforms are reconstructed at representative positions inside the surviving warehouse sector. The mapped continuation to the north gives the exit bearing. Fine roof remnants, mortar color and rail details are approximate.
The separately named merchant house, former residence, cafe, garden attractions and landscape beyond the old warehouse are outside scope.
